console.egg: Curious? The draw is AES-GCM. Whoever peeks here has not understood the game.
rule.schrottwichteln: Buy nothing, only what you already have.
rule.advent-engerl: Every week of Advent, a small secret joy. The reveal is on {date}.
wizard.who.title: Who plays?
wizard.who.roundTitleHelp: Only for your overview on this device. The name goes into no draw.
wizard.who.namesHelp: A blank line separates groups, such as a household, couple, family or team. People in the same group do not draw each other. Without a blank line, everyone plays on their own.
wizard.rules.title: Rules
wizard.rules.intro: Everything here is optional. If you change nothing: people in the same group do not draw each other, and nobody gives to someone who gives to them.
wizard.rules.noMutualHelp: Two people never give to each other.
wizard.rules.oneChainHelp: Everyone hangs in one circle. Needed if you reveal in turn.
wizard.rules.hintNote: Only what the Engerl needs to know. No diagnoses needed: ‘no nuts’ is enough.
wizard.rules.weekThemes: Theme for each week of Advent
wizard.rules.weekThemesHelp: Optional. Each theme is for one week, such as “something sweet” or “homemade”.
wizard.rules.addressesHelp: Each address appears only in the draw of the Engerl who sends to that person. It is stored only on this device.
wizard.rules.lastYearHelp: Who gave to whom last year? These pairings will not happen this year.
wizard.map.title: Who is who?
wizard.map.help: These names from {year} are missing from the list. If someone goes by a different name now, match the new name.
wizard.rules.exclusionsHelp: Who should not draw whom? For example siblings, or a boss and their team.
wizard.rules.exclusionTextBoth: {from} and {to} do not draw each other
wizard.rules.mustHelp: Who must give to whom? Several ticks mean: one of these people.
wizard.rules.mustChoices: gives to one of these people
draw.impossible: With these rules there is no valid draw.
draw.noChain: With these rules there is no big chain.
draw.tooStrict: The rules are too strict for a fair draw. {rule} got in the way most often. Loosen this rule and try again.

draw.tooLong.one: The draw for {names} is too long. Shorten the hint by {count} character.
draw.tooLong.other: The draw for {names} is too long. Shorten the hint by {count} characters.

draw.failed: The draw did not work. Reload the page and try again.
round.title: Round for {date}
round.hint: Send each link in a one-to-one chat, never in the group.
round.copied: Link copied. Paste it now in your one-to-one chat with {name}.
round.shareFailed: Sharing and copying did not work. Try again.
round.allSent: All draws are on their way.
round.safari: Safari deletes this site's data after seven days without a visit. Add the app to your home screen so that “Send again” keeps working.
round.framed: Inside an embedded window there is no sending and no emergency view. Open the app directly.
round.expiresSoon: This round deletes itself on {date}. Save it for next year before then.
year.title: Remember for next year
year.titleHint: A file so that nobody draws the same person next year
year.help: The file holds names, groups, pairings, budget and hints. Next year, open it on the start page with “Open file”.
year.noPasswordWarning: Without a password, anyone who has the file can read the assignment and the hints.
year.saved: Saved. Keep the file somewhere safe.
backup.title: Save backup
backup.titleHint: For another device or a second organizer
backup.help: The backup holds the whole round with all links. On the other device, open it on the start page with “Open file”.
backup.noPasswordWarning: Without a password, the round with all links is in the file. Whoever has the file can read who drew whom, just as on this device.
backup.saved: Saved. Keep the file somewhere safe.
backup.replace: This round is already on this device. Here: draw no. {here}. In the file: draw no. {file}. Replace it with the backup?
round.duringHint: Drop-out, draw again, emergency, delete round
round.duringHintStage: Drop-out, draw again, emergency, reveal, delete round
round.sealWarning: Afterwards nothing is left on this device. Lost links can only be replaced by a new draw.
round.sealed: Sealed. Nothing of this round is left on this device.
round.deleteWarning: The round and all links disappear from this device. Draws already sent stay valid.
round.redrawWarning: Everyone gets a new link. Tell the group that only draw no. {n} counts; old links still open.
round.redrawn: Drawn again. Now send everyone their new draw.
round.removeOk: {engerl} gets a new link. Nothing else changes.
round.removeBroken: Afterwards the rules no longer hold in full. Only a new draw guarantees them.
round.removeSelf: {engerl} would draw themselves. That only works with a new draw.
round.removed: {name} is no longer playing. Now send {engerl} the new link.
round.tooFewLeft: With fewer than two people there is no round left.
round.changed: The round has changed in the meantime. Please check again.
stage.title: Start reveal
stage.titleHint: Pair by pair on this device, for the party
stage.titleHintEarly: Before the exchange date only with “Ich spicke”
stage.help: The app shows one pair after another and follows the chain: whoever was just given a gift is next.
stage.early: The exchange date has not come yet. As with the emergency view, the reveal then needs “Ich spicke”, and it is logged.
stage.logEntry: Reveal started before the exchange date on {date}
emergency.title: Emergency: view assignment
emergency.intro: Only for real emergencies, one person at a time. Every view stays in the log.
emergency.wrongPhrase: Please type exactly “Ich spicke” or hold the button.
emergency.setPinHint: Optional, if others use this device too
emergency.pinNote: The PIN is a hurdle in the app, not encryption.
years.title: From last year

years.pairings.one: 1 pairing will be excluded next time
years.pairings.other: {count} pairings will be excluded next time

years.forgetWarning: The names and pairings of {year} disappear from this device.
file.title: Open file
file.label: File
file.needsPassword: The file is protected with a password.
file.invalid: The app cannot read this file.
rounds.title: Your rounds on this device
prefill.title: New round from a link
prefill.intro: Someone sent you a ready invitation. Check the details; nothing is drawn until you say so.
prefill.failed: This link cannot set up a round.
los.title: Your draw
los.note: Nothing is stored. You can look at your draw again at any time through the link in the chat.
los.invalidHelp: The link is incomplete or changed. Ask the organizer to send it again.
error.name.tooLong: Names may have at most {max} characters.
error.people.tooFew: At least two people are needed.
error.households.invalid: The name list cannot be read.
error.amount.invalid: The budget must be a number between 0 and {max}.
error.date.invalid: Please choose a valid exchange date.
error.title.tooLong: The name of the round may have at most {max} characters.
error.date.past: The exchange date is in the past. Please choose a day from today on.
error.config.invalid: Something about the settings is not right.
error.config.version: These settings come from another version.
error.rule.mustEmpty: A must rule needs at least one person.
error.rule.mustTwice: There is already a must rule for {name}.
error.prefill.version: The app does not know this version of the link.
error.unexpected: Something went wrong. Reload the page and try again.
game.namesHelp: Blank lines do not count here. The order applies if you do not play in random order; for “youngest first”, type the names that way.
game.endWarning: The game ends, and its state is deleted from this device.
game.ended: The game has ended and is deleted.
game.runningItem: {game} with {people}. It deletes itself 24 hours after it started.
raeuber.title: Räuberwichteln
raeuber.intro: Everyone brings one wrapped gift. In turn, a player unwraps a new one or steals an unwrapped one.
raeuber.lockAfterHelp: After that, a gift stays where it is. 3 is usual.
raeuber.lockInvalid: Please enter a number from 1 to 9.
raeuber.finalSwapHelp: At the end, the first player may swap their gift for one that is not locked.
raeuber.robbed: {name} was robbed. Gift {n} cannot be taken straight back.
raeuber.choice: Unwrap a new gift or steal an unwrapped one.
raeuber.label: What is inside? (optional)
raeuber.labelHelp: A word like “socks” helps to tell the gifts apart.
raeuber.labelTooLong: The word has at most {max} characters.
raeuber.finalHelp: Swapping works only with a gift that is not locked. Whoever does not want to swap keeps theirs.
wuerfel.title: Würfelwichteln
wuerfel.intro: The gifts lie in the middle. In turn, everyone rolls the die, and the number says what happens, until the time is up.
wuerfel.minutesHelp: 15 minutes is usual. The screen stays on while the time runs.
wuerfel.minutesInvalid: Please enter a number from 1 to {max}.
wuerfel.soundHelp: A short tone and, where possible, a vibration when the time is up.
wuerfel.rulesHint: Six rules, each can be changed
wuerfel.rulesHelp: What happens with which number. Change what you play differently.
wuerfel.rule.3: Swap with the person on the left
wuerfel.rule.4: Swap with the person on the right
wuerfel.rule.6: Take a gift from the middle
wuerfel.ruleInvalid: Every rule needs text, at most {max} characters.
wuerfel.drinkHelp: Optional, and only for groups who want it.
wuerfel.drinkDefault: Whoever rolls a 1 also takes a sip.
wuerfel.overHelp: Everyone keeps what they hold right now. Time to unwrap.
zufall.title: Zufallswichteln
zufall.intro: Everyone brings a gift for a person nobody knows yet. Only now does the phone draw who gets whose gift.
zufall.nothingStored: Nothing is stored and there are no links. After a reload the draw is gone.
zufall.forgotten: As soon as you leave this page, the draw is forgotten.
page.title: SecretEngerl: Engerl-Bengerl, the Austrian Secret Santa, without a server
page.description: Draw Engerl-Bengerl, the Austrian Secret Santa, fairly. Everyone gets their draw as a private, encrypted link. No server, no account.
page.ogDescription: Engerl-Bengerl, Wichteln and Secret Santa without a server.
page.license: Open source under MIT. All texts are machine-written.
page.aiFix: Spotted a mistake? Tell us on GitHub.
page.noscript: The app needs JavaScript to draw. The explanations read fine without it.
home.headline: Draw Engerl-Bengerl, without any server.
home.lead: Engerl-Bengerl, the Austrian Secret Santa: enter names, draw fairly, send each draw privately.
home.templates: How do you want to play?
home.gamesLead: No draw in advance and no links: the game runs on one phone at the party.
home.promiseLead: Names, hints and draws stay with you. They are stored only here:
home.serverText: Nothing. There is no server; the app runs entirely in your browser.
home.deviceText: The round with names and links, so that you can send a link again. It deletes itself 14 days after the exchange, or right away if you want. A game at the table stays for at most 24 hours.
home.chatText: Each link with its encrypted draw, for as long as the chat keeps it.
home.openText: Nothing. The draw is only shown, not stored.
card.engerl-bengerl: With a budget and an exchange date. People in the same group do not draw each other.
card.schrottwichteln: Buy nothing, only give what you already have.
card.familien-wichteln: With hints for each person and without last year's pairings.
card.buero-wichteln: A small budget, a theme if you like.
card.post-wichteln: Gifts by post. Each address appears only in the Engerl's draw.
card.advent-engerl: A small secret joy every week of Advent, a theme if you like.
card.raeuberwichteln: In turn, unwrap or steal. A gift is locked after three steals.
card.wuerfelwichteln: Roll the die in turn; the number decides who takes and who swaps. With a timer.
card.zufallswichteln: Everyone brings a gift. The phone draws who gets which one only at the party.
